head: Mentalist Calculator: a calculator app that hides 8 magic tricks
dek: Mentalist Calculator looks and works like a normal iPhone calculator but hides eight mind-reading effects you can perform without cards or props. It costs $6.99 and was #46 in paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: The effects include predicting the date and time, guessing a secret number or birthday, an envelope prediction, a photo prediction and a phone that switches off and shows a number on its wallpaper. Each comes with step-by-step instructions, in English or Italian. The listing says it works offline, collects no data, has no ads or accounts, and clears typed numbers when closed. It's made by Federico De Florio and came out on 22 November.
where: iPhone and iPad with iOS 16 or later; $6.99
means: If you like doing tricks at the dinner table, this turns your phone's calculator into the prop.
todo: It's a one-time $6.99 on the App Store; read each trick's steps before you try it on friends.
